Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review: one blocker.

The trace tests cover X, Y and XY mirrors for all 12 mill posts. Both documented mutations fail as expected. Probing stays refused in the ten new dialects. I read all ten new goldens line by line.

### Requested before merge

1. **Correct the Heidenhain helix proof before enabling this path.** `assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:22` enables a flipped WCS with a helix. The new golden, `crates/post/tests/golden/wcs_flip/heidenhain_x.nc:12`, writes `G02 X-30 Y+10 Z+2.75` after an absolute `I J` centre block. Line 14 writes the next descending half turn in the same form. However, the cited TNC 640 manual states that a helix uses polar coordinates only. Its example uses `G12 G91 H-1800 Z+5`, not Cartesian `G02 X Y Z`. See the [HEIDENHAIN ISO Programming User's Manual, ID 892909-25, pages 271–272](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/TNC640/34059x-07/diniso/892909-25.pdf). The new reader accepts the Cartesian blocks as helices at `crates/post/tests/mirror_trace/mod.rs:335–343`. Thus, its green result does not prove the control's path. The body records this form as not judged, but the new mirror flag now permits it where the engine previously refused the script. Emit a documented helix form, or refuse this case by name. Make the reader enforce the dialect's rule, then update the golden and run the safety tests again.

### Local build and tests

The PR trial-merges cleanly with upstream/main `a85900ac59582c9b1e0d409e9051b51dbec8919a`. All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2749`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 151 steps, 0 failed |
| Post checks in the gate | 93 test steps; 783 passed |
| App checks in the gate | 56 test steps; 746 passed, 1 ignored |
| Post `wcs_flip` / `inverted_post` | 15 / 16 passed |
| App `wcs_flip` / `wcs_flip_post` | 7 / 10 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The first cached gate attempt passed the post phase, then stopped making visible progress in the app build. I interrupted it. The complete retry used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` and passed. An initial plan also selected batch before the local trial merge was committed; I stopped that attempt and corrected the local merge setup.

### Extra suites run

`cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test wcs_flip_dialects`: 7 passed. A source search found this suite as the reader of the changed `golden/wcs_flip` directory. No importer code or STEP fixture changed, so the extra importer suites do not apply.

### Mutations run independently

- Restored all ten changed mill scripts to upstream/main: all 7 dialect tests failed. Restored the PR scripts: all 7 passed.
- Removed the Mach4 section-end `wcsFlip` reset: `a_plain_section_after_a_flipped_one_writes_no_flip_note` failed. Restored the reset: it passed.

All mutation edits were restored. The worktree was clean after the checks. No program ran on a control. No UI code changed, so screenshots do not apply.

Nonblocking note: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:85` and `:197` still describe Fanuc and Haas as the only supported posts. The PR records this limitation.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Correct the Heidenhain helix proof.

The post now refuses a native XY helix by operation name. It names the required polar interpolation. Planar arcs and existing chord paths remain covered.

`heidenhain_refuses_cartesian_helices_by_operation_name` pins the refusal for plain, X, Y and XY sections.

The reader now rejects Cartesian Heidenhain helices. `heidenhain_reader_rejects_cartesian_helices` pins G02/G03 with I/J or R. It also checks planar arcs and RS-274 helices.

The mirrored Heidenhain golden now uses the planar fixture. The recorded arcs and tool-change fixtures expect the helix refusal.

Each new guard was removed separately. Its pin failed. Each guard was restored. Its pin passed. All 9 dialect tests passed.

The quick gate passed: 150 steps, 0 failed. Post tests: 785 passed. App tests: 736 passed, 1 ignored. Clippy passed on camcraft-post and camcraft-app, all targets, with -D warnings.

New head: 2ed5597e07707f4a25e62afe6b5b3ef97d144a85.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. SAFETY-tier review. No blocking findings.

### Earlier finding checked

The Heidenhain helix finding is resolved. `assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:594` refuses a native Cartesian XY helix by operation name. The refusal applies to plain, X, Y and XY sections. `crates/post/tests/mirror_trace/mod.rs:334` rejects the same unsupported form in the reader. The two new tests check these guards separately.

I read all ten new mirrored-program goldens and the changed Heidenhain recorded goldens line by line. The Heidenhain mirror golden now uses the planar fixture. The recorded `arcs` case now expects the named refusal. The `tool_change` case also records the helix refusals. The planar arcs and vertical chord paths keep their trace checks.

The trace tests compare physical cuts and compensation sides for all 12 mill posts. They cover X, Y and XY mirrors. The standard program must fail the reversed-controller comparison. Probing stays refused in the ten new dialects.

### Local build and tests

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2749`, trial-merged with upstream/main `bbd28cccc55ec89ae9bcc1a3dd9140de9e0b84d6`. The merge was clean. No GitHub runner was used. The checks used a separate target directory, with the compiler cache disabled.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 151 steps, 0 failed; 7.5 minutes |
| Post tests selected by the gate | 785 passed |
| App tests selected by the gate | 746 passed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

### Extra suites run

Source searches found the readers of the changed golden directories. I also ran these suites explicitly after the quick gate:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test wcs_flip_dialects`: 9 passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test script_heidenhain`: 11 passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test recorded_streams`: 12 passed.

No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra importer suites do not apply. No UI code changed, so screenshots do not apply.

### Mutations run independently

- Restored all ten mill scripts to upstream/main: 8 dialect tests failed; the reader guard test passed. Restored the PR scripts: all 9 passed.
- Removed the Mach4 section-end `wcsFlip` reset: `a_plain_section_after_a_flipped_one_writes_no_flip_note` failed. Restored the reset: it passed.
- Removed the Heidenhain post guard: `heidenhain_refuses_cartesian_helices_by_operation_name` failed. Restored the guard: it passed.
- Removed the reader guard: `heidenhain_reader_rejects_cartesian_helices` failed. Restored the guard: it passed.

All mutation edits were restored. All 9 dialect tests passed again on the restored tree. The worktree was clean after the checks.

### Requested before merge

None.

Nonblocking note: the two Fanuc/Haas-only statements in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` remain stale. The PR records this limitation.

No program ran on a control. The PR body names the cycle and machine cases that were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
